next_cursor.description: NextCursor is present only when a later page exists; pass it as cursor.

prev_cursor.description: PrevCursor is present only when an earlier page exists; pass it as before.

subjects.description:
Subjects is one page of the grant holders, ordered by kind then
case-insensitive name. The counts above are totals on every page,
whatever the kind filter or cursor.

email.description: Email is a user's primary email; absent for a group or a user without one.

source.description:
Source is a group's provenance, as stored; absent for any other kind.
Clients own any display mapping of the raw value.

code.description:
Code is the specific machine-readable reason within Type. Optional: a
message-only error omits it.

message.description: Message is the human-readable description, safe to show to the caller.

type.description:
Type is the broad class of the error. Optional: a message-only error
omits it.
